posts.title: AI Lip Sync and Film Dubbing: An Early Look at Flawless AI
posts.description: Dubbed dialogue can leave a mismatch between the words and the movements of a speaker’s mouth. This archival explanation introduces Flawless AI’s proposal to change those movements digitally. It considers an application of AI while leaving claims about perfect results open to testing.

posts.title: Apple M1 and System-on-Chip Design: A Neighborhood Analogy
posts.description: A fast computer is useful when its strengths match your work. This M1-era comparison uses vehicles to explain why the most expensive machine is not always the best fit. The practical lesson is to compare the tasks you actually run.

posts.title: Brilliant Minds and Fragile Minds: Thinking About Certainty
posts.description: Confidence does not tell us whether an idea is true. This personal reflection contrasts a willingness to learn with the habit of defending an answer at any cost. The invitation is to stay curious and check the evidence.
